verdict.rationale: Slack's Events API lets developers subscribe to specific event types via webhook (public HTTP endpoint) or Socket Mode, with Slack calling the subscriber's endpoint on events — a core webhook-subscription mechanism well documented for building AI/agentic integrations. Workflow Builder also supports webhook triggers for starting workflows externally, reinforcing webhook-based event subscription. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of webhook reliability at scale, and more explicit framing of Events API webhooks specifically for AI-native/agent consumption (most AI-agent docs emphasize MCP/Web API rather than raw event webhooks).
